weighting: equal group/condition/item before class weighting; class factors fitted on train, then renormalize each group; same fixed total loss mass for all six fits
training: legacy=R10 train120 questions; expanded=R10 train120 plus R16 train301
calibration: R16 validation49 questions only, separate max-F1 thresholds for windows and answer max; no C search
evaluation: R16 test50 questions in49 groups; all six models and thresholds frozen first; no retuning after test
window_geometry: all parsed answer ranges, raw BPE width4/stride1; short range allowed; omit purely nonlexical windows; no gold-based proposal selection
window_gold: OR over eligible lexical token gold; unresolved and safe refusals not localization labels
answer_score: maximum window probability over all generated answer candidate windows, including refusals; no gold-dependent override
answer_gold: frozen reviewed safe refusal0; supported0; unsupported/contradicted1; unresolved excluded
highlight: union of windows above validation window threshold; no separate token threshold
limitations: assistant annotations rather than researcher human gold
C and width informed by earlier training experiments
